summary: Oddity Tech's subsidiary Oddity Finance repurchased $50M of its 0% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2030 for $35M, implying a 30% discount. Closing expected June 17, 2026; after the transaction, $550M principal remains outstanding. This is a liability management transaction and a return of capital to noteholders, effectively reducing leverage. No board recommendation or advisors named. The repurchase is privately negotiated, subject to customary conditions. Watch for potential further liability management or equity-linked conversions; the discount is a positive for remaining noteholders but reduces the size of the outstanding exchangeable security.
